svg.title: ProofBerry Candidate Recourse Path
svg.desc: An illustrative one-role staffing design-partner card showing a candidate question, correction, support, and human escalation path around AI-assisted evidence collection.
svg.text: Give the candidate a path back.
Illustrative early-access pilot protocol · consequential decisions stay human-owned.

g.text: Where is AI used, what evidence is requested, and who reviews it?
State the step and the human decision owner before the candidate begins.
Name the person or channel that can explain the process.
Do not make the candidate guess where to ask what the evidence step means.
If evidence is misunderstood, preserve the candidate's clarification.
A correction request is review input — not an automatic score or outcome change.
04 · ROUTE SUPPORT / EXCEPTIONS TO A HUMAN
Document who handles access, accommodation, or unusual process needs.
Available choices and obligations depend on the employer process and applicable requirements.
Record the question, response, unresolved issue, and accountable reviewer.
The pilot measures whether the handoff is clearer — not whether AI replaces judgment.

svg.text: Before the first AI-assisted step, can the candidate see how to reach a human?

Early-access design method only. No claim of legal compliance, validated selection performance, identity verification, fraud detection, bias elimination, ATS integration, ROI, placement improvement, or automatic hiring.
